messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync  We're getting several enterprise asks for stronger tenant isolation + clearer pricing bands. Need a prioritization proposal by EOW.
Leo (Arch): Proposal: define discrete isolation tiers instead of bespoke per-tenant configs. Example tiers: bronze/silver/gold, each covering network, compute, and KV cache surfaces.
Sam (Eng): Tiers look feasible. Rough mapping: bronze = shared pools with soft affinity; silver = dedicated slices with soft-eviction policies; gold = isolated pools with strict no-fallback rules.
Anne (SRE): Call out failover behavior: silver allows controlled cross-slice fallback under pressure; gold forbids automatic fallback (manual escalation only). That will change SLA exposures.
Rick (Sales): Customers want predictable latency and data separation. They'll ask for pricing deltas for gold vs silver  need rough %s to guide talks.
Maya (PM): Action items: Leo + Sam draft a tech spec and cost implications; Anne to author SLO matrix + rollback triggers; Rick to collect customer WTP examples.
Leo (Arch): Trade-offs: more pools -> higher ops cost and lower capacity efficiency. Also complexity in cross-region routing if gold tenants are region-pinned.
Sam (Eng): Implementation note: add tenancy_tier attribute to routing decisions. Example rule: match tenant in gold_list -> route to dedicated_pool:us-west-1-gold with policy=no_fallback.
Maya (PM): Include migration paths: self-serve, SE-assisted, and fully-managed migrations. Outline UX requirements for migration.
Anne (SRE): Rollout plan: pilot with 2 willing non-critical gold tenants for 6 weeks. Success metrics: p99 latency within target, <1% fallback, incident rate change <= baseline. Rollback if metrics worsen >10%.
Rick (Sales): For contract language: "Gold SLA: 99.95% uptime, p99 latency <250ms, data residency EU/US as requested." Is 99.95% realistic?
Leo (Arch): 99.95% needs multi-region replication or active-active. If we pin gold to a single region, SLA should reflect that unless we also offer gold-ha.
Sam (Eng): Suggest two gold variants: gold-local (single-region) and gold-ha (multi-region active-active). Sales can sell gold-local at lower price and gold-ha as premium.
Maya (PM): Tentative pricing buckets: bronze (base), silver (+20%), gold-local (+60%), gold-ha (+150%)  placeholders for finance to refine.
Anne (SRE): Runbook items: eviction soft-timers, noisy-tenant quiesce play, on-call escalation for cross-pool failures. Need these before pilot.
Leo (Arch): KV cache isolation: gold must use dedicated caches to avoid poisoning and tail-latency spikes. Document memory footprint vs GPU tradeoffs.
Maya (PM): Deliverables this week: 1) spec doc with isolation surfaces and tier definitions, 2) migration experience matrix, 3) SLO & rollback checklist, 4) short cost model.
Sam (Eng): I'll put a spec stub in infra repo under docs/isolation-tiers and link PR here.
Rick (Sales): I'll line up 3 pilot customers: one EU-regulated, one startup, one fintech. Need pricing and contract language drafts.
infra-bot: Deploy preview for routing-policy-dsl is up: https://ci.example.com/builds/4582  tests: routing-policy-unit, fallback-sim.
Anne (SRE): Requesting a routing-layer experiment to simulate affinity decay and measure spill rates for silver-tier tenants under real load.
Leo (Arch): Agreed. Plan: replay two weeks of traces with the new tenancy_tier policy in sandbox and measure spill rate, p99, and cost delta. Sam to run.
Maya (PM): Next check-in Thursday 10am. Update the spec PR and drop links here. Urgent issues ping @Leo. :thumbsup:
